notes:
- Info page respects your list status: A title already on your list no longer offers to add it to Planning on the Info page: it shows the status you gave it (watching, completed, paused, dropped, repeating) instead, so a finished show cannot be silently moved back to Planning.
- Downloadable poster: The Info page's Extras card now saves the best available artwork - BetterPosters when you chose it, otherwise AniList's cover - to your gallery, so a poster you like can be kept at full resolution.
